title: Registry settings for the remaining fields and the global cap

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
Closes parity row 7.2 and the "Registry settings for the remaining fields and the global cap" gap (docs/orchestrator-parity.md, section 7; the Prioritized gaps table, gap 9). `ork projects set` changes nine optional fields (S161; `internal/cli/daemoncmds.go:213-321`). Five registry fields have no command and are file edits (`docs/state.md:94-99`): `environment_lines`, `permissions` and `vendor_env` per project, and `global_cap` and `daemon_idle_minutes` for the whole registry.

Owner decision 2026-10-29: this gap is v1.0 (everything except S173, S179 and S180 is).

Facts checked on 2026-10-29:
- The five fields exist in the registry types: `Project.EnvironmentLines`, `Project.Permissions`, `Project.VendorEnv`, `File.GlobalCap`, `File.DaemonIdleMinutes` (`internal/registry/registry.go:110-141`). `Load` reads strict keys (`registry.go:172`), and `Save` writes atomically (`registry.go:250`).
- How the daemon uses them: the global cap is read for every admission (`hasRoomLocked`, `internal/daemon/runs.go:726-745`; unset or 0 means 4, `registry.zero-values`, #57). `daemon_idle_minutes` is read each time the idle clock arms (`internal/daemon/daemon.go:202-207`; unset or 0 means 10, `daemon.idle`, #60). Environment lines go into every role brief (`internal/engine/round.go:234`, `internal/engine/speccheck.go:179`). Permissions are resolved per role by `ResolvePermission` (`internal/engine/perm.go:47-72`): the implementer takes a preset (`read-only`) or an allowlist, and the reviewer, gate, architect, UI pass and spec check are read-only and refuse an allowlist. Vendor env is added to the environment of that vendor's processes (`internal/daemon/runs.go:162-171`).
- `projects.set` is the model to follow (`internal/daemon/handlers.go:460-565`): pointer fields, validation before the registry lock, a refusal while the project has unfinished runs, one `Save`. Its "no field set" check compares the params struct with `==` (`handlers.go:467`; the CLI does the same at `daemoncmds.go:266`). Slice and map fields make the struct non-comparable, so both comparisons change.
- The registry file is written at mode 0644 (`registry.go:277`). `vendor_env` values can therefore be read by other users of the machine. The state doc shows it only for a switch (`VENDOR_CODEX_NETWORK`). ork never reads vendor credentials (`AGENTS.md`), and the state doc says no ork file holds secrets (`docs/state.md:451`: "No secrets"). This slice does not change that, and the docs say `vendor_env` is not a place for secrets.
- slicer and adj do not own any of this. These are ork's own files (`docs/state.md`, `docs/boundaries.md`).

What this slice adds (all *proposed* until an adj record decides it):
- `ork projects set NAME` gains `--env-line LINE` (repeatable; the given lines replace the list; one empty `--env-line ""` clears it), `--permission ROLE=read-only` (sets the preset) and `--permission ROLE=` (removes the role's entry, so the default applies), `--allow ROLE=PATTERN` (repeatable; the patterns given for a role replace that role's list), and `--vendor-env VENDOR:KEY=VALUE` (repeatable; sets one key) with `--unset-vendor-env VENDOR:KEY` (repeatable; removes one key and the vendor once it is empty). Permissions and vendor env are changed one role or one key at a time so that a second command does not need the first one's values again (Open 3).
- `ork settings show` and `ork settings set [--global-cap N] [--daemon-idle-minutes N]` for the two file-level fields (Open 1). 0 clears a value. The effective values (4 and 10 minutes when unset) are printed.
- Daemon: `projects.set` takes the three new field groups; new methods `settings.get` and `settings.set`. `settings.set` is not refused while runs are unfinished, because the global cap is read for every admission and the idle clock for every arming. Raising the cap starts queued runs that now fit; lowering it never stops a running one.
- Text output names the fields and counts, and never prints a `vendor_env` value.

Not in this slice: a TUI editor for registry fields (Open 2), `name`, `path` and `adj` (set by `projects add`), per-vendor caps (S169, which should extend `ork settings` after this slice), and `.claude/settings.json` rules (parity row 7.3, none proposed).

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- `TestValidateEnvLineAndVendorEnv` (`internal/registry/registry_test.go`): a blank line, a line with a newline or NUL, a vendor name outside `[a-z0-9_-]`, a key that is not a shell name (`[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*`), and a NUL in a value are refused; ordinary lines and keys pass.
- `TestProjectsSetEnvironmentPermissionsAndVendorEnv` (`internal/daemon/daemon_test.go`): one call sets env lines, an implementer allowlist, a read-only preset for the reviewer and two vendor keys; a second call that sets one more key leaves the first; `null` for a role removes its entry; an emptied vendor disappears; every other registry key stays as it was.
- `TestProjectsSetValidatesTheNewFields` (`internal/daemon/daemon_test.go`): an unknown role, an allowlist for a read-only role (through `engine.ResolvePermission`), a preset other than `read-only`, an empty pattern, and the bad env and vendor values of the registry test each give `bad_params` and change nothing.
- `TestProjectsSetNewFieldsRefuseAnUnfinishedRun` (`internal/daemon/daemon_test.go`): the new groups are refused with `project_busy` like the old fields; a call that sets nothing is still `bad_params` ("sets no field") although the params struct is no longer comparable.
- `TestSettingsSetSavesGlobalCapAndIdleMinutes` (`internal/daemon/settings_test.go`): both fields save; 0 clears; a negative number is `bad_params`; a call with neither field is `bad_params`; projects and other keys are untouched; the call works with an unfinished run.
- `TestSettingsGetReportsEffectiveValues` (`internal/daemon/settings_test.go`): unset gives 4 and 10; a set value is returned with its effective value.
- `TestRaisingTheGlobalCapStartsQueuedRuns` (`internal/daemon/runs_test.go`): with a cap of 1, one running and one queued run, `settings.set` to 2 starts the queued run without another event; lowering the cap stops nothing.
- `TestProjectsSetEnvLinePermissionAndAllowFlags` (`internal/cli/cli_test.go`): `--env-line` twice, `--permission reviewer=read-only`, `--allow implementer=Read --allow implementer=Grep` and `--vendor-env codex:A=1` become one `projects.set` call with the right params; `--env-line ""` clears; the text line names the fields.
- `TestProjectsSetNeverPrintsVendorEnvValues` (`internal/cli/cli_test.go`): text output and the error text of a refused call contain the keys and no value.
- `TestProjectsSetNewFlagUsageErrors` (`internal/cli/cli_test.go`): `--allow` or `--permission` without `=`, `--vendor-env` without `:` or `=`, `--unset-vendor-env` without `:`, and `--permission R=read-only` together with `--allow R=x` exit 2 before the daemon is dialed.
- `TestSettingsSetAndShow` (`internal/cli/settings_test.go`): `ork settings set --global-cap 6 --daemon-idle-minutes 0` calls `settings.set`; text `updated settings: global_cap=6, daemon_idle_minutes=unset`; `show` prints stored and effective values, and `--json` prints them as `{"settings":{...}}`.
- `TestSettingsUsage` (`internal/cli/settings_test.go`): no subcommand, no flag, a negative number and a non-number exit 2.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
UI slice: UI pass (r14). It changes `internal/cli` output and the docs only; there is no TUI part (Open 2). Write the failing tests first.

1. `internal/registry/registry.go:80-105`: add `ValidateEnvLine(line)`, `ValidateVendorEnv(vendor, key, value)` and `ValidatePermissionEntry(role string, p Permission)` beside `ValidateUIDoc` and `ValidatePattern`, in their style (return an error that names the field). A permission entry must be either the preset `read-only` or a list of non-blank patterns without NUL or newline; pattern syntax per vendor stays unchecked (`docs/state.md:101-103`). Do not add the checks to `Load`/`Validate` (`registry.go:172-248`): a hand-edited file that loads today must keep loading.
2. `internal/daemon/wire.go:250-262`: extend `SetProjectParams` with `EnvironmentLines *[]string`, `Permissions map[string]*registry.Permission` (null removes a role) and `VendorEnv map[string]map[string]*string` (null removes a key). Add `func (p SetProjectParams) setsNothing() bool` that checks every field, and use it at `handlers.go:467` and in the CLI (`daemoncmds.go:266`) in place of the struct comparison.
3. `internal/daemon/handlers.go:460-565` (`setProject`): validate the new values with the registry functions before `regMu`. After the load and the unfinished-run check, apply the three groups to a copy of the project, then for every role in the permissions patch call `engine.ResolvePermission(candidate, role)` (`internal/engine/perm.go:47`); its error becomes `bad_params`. Then save once, as today.
4. `internal/daemon/settings.go` (new): `MethodSettingsGet = "settings.get"` and `MethodSettingsSet = "settings.set"` in `wire.go:17-33`; `SetSettingsParams{GlobalCap *int; DaemonIdleMinutes *int}` and `SettingsResult{GlobalCap, DaemonIdleMinutes, EffectiveGlobalCap, EffectiveDaemonIdleMinutes int}`. `setSettings`: refuse no field and negatives with `bad_params`; take `regMu`, load, set, hold `d.runs.mu` through `registry.Save` as `setProject` does, and then call `d.startQueuedLocked(f)` (`runs.go:748-760`) before unlocking, so a raised cap starts queued runs. Effective values: `defaultGlobalCap` (`runs.go:44`) and `registry.DefaultDaemonIdleMinutes` (`registry.go:27`). Dispatch in `handlers.go:61-170`; `Client.SetSettings` and `Client.Settings` beside `SetProject` (`client.go:70-74`).
5. `internal/cli/daemoncmds.go:213-321`: add a `stringList` flag type (`flag.Value`) for the repeatable flags. `--permission` and `--allow` parse `ROLE=VALUE` (split on the first `=`); `--vendor-env` parses `VENDOR:KEY=VALUE` (first `:`, then first `=`); `--unset-vendor-env` parses `VENDOR:KEY`. `--permission R=read-only` plus `--allow R=...` is a usage error. Build the params with `fs.Visit` as the existing flags do. The text summary lists `environment_lines=N lines`, `permissions=ROLE:preset|N patterns`, `vendor_env=VENDOR:KEY,KEY`; no values. Update the "needs at least one field flag" text (`daemoncmds.go:266-268`).
6. `internal/cli/settings.go` (new): `ork settings show|set` over `settings.get` and `settings.set`. Usage text and dispatch: `cli.go:40-77`, `cli.go:173-205`.
7. Docs: `docs/state.md:94-105` (the fields are no longer file edits; `settings set` writes `global_cap` and `daemon_idle_minutes`; add the secrets sentence about `vendor_env` and mode 0644), `docs/state.md:444-450` (zero means unset for `daemon_idle_minutes` is unchanged), `docs/design.md:1205-1240` (the new flags and `settings`, and that `settings set` is not refused while runs are unfinished), `docs/manual-steps.md:39-56` (a row for each file edit this replaces). Doctor's pattern hint (`internal/cli/doctor.go:190`) is unchanged.

Order: S169 (per-vendor slot cap) also needs a global setting; it should run after this slice and extend `ork settings`. S166, S170, S171, S172 and S178 share `cli.go` (usage text, dispatch): merge main before the gate, and keep the usage text in alphabetical-by-purpose order as it stands.

Open (for the owner; the defaults below are what the steps above implement):
1. Where do `global_cap` and `daemon_idle_minutes` live? Options: (A) a new `ork settings show|set` command (default; recommended: they are not per project, and S169 needs the same home); (B) flags on `ork projects set` with no NAME, e.g. `ork projects set --global-cap 6`; (C) leave them file edits and only add the three project fields.
2. Does this slice include a TUI view of the registry settings? Options: (A) no, CLI only (default; recommended: the TUI has no project-settings view today, and `projects set` is CLI only); (B) a read-only settings view; (C) an editor.
3. How do permissions and vendor env change? Options: (A) per role and per key, as above (default; recommended: no value has to be typed twice, and a value is never echoed); (B) replace the whole map from one JSON argument or a file (`--permissions-json FILE`).

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- `go test -race -count=1 ./...`
- `go vet ./...`
- `gofmt -l .` (prints nothing)
- `slicer check --root /Users/jon/code/squalor-xyz/ork`
- `adj lint --root /Users/jon/code/squalor-xyz/ork`
- No TUI goldens change. If `go test ./internal/tui -update` changes any file in `testdata/golden/`, that is a defect.
- Manual, on a copy of the registry only (`XDG_CONFIG_HOME` pointing at a scratch directory in `.scratch/`): `ork settings set --global-cap 2`, `ork settings show`, `ork projects set NAME --env-line "x" --allow implementer=Read`, then read `projects.json`. Never against the owner's live registry.
